name: Mock Extractor
description: Manually save mock test questions from Testbook, Parmar Academy, RBE, and Parmar-style 'multiple' MCQ platforms into one shared pool that persists across mocks, export as a single HTML file, auto-attach a matching YouTube solution timestamp synced from a hosted map, and post them to a Telegram group as either auto-graded quiz polls or revotable practice polls with a spoiler-tagged rich-text answer reveal.
